description: A4/H3 golden fixture — _haircut_select must select from the SAME trial list it scores. The t-stat loop iterates the UNFILTERED completed_trials (autotuner.py:1472) and builds p_adj over that index space, but returns filtered_trials[winner_idx] (autotuner.py:1519) where filtered_trials has the SORTINO_SENTINEL trials removed. When a sentinel trial precedes a real trial AND the sentinel's series wins the argmin, winner_idx points at the sentinel's position in completed-space, so filtered_trials[winner_idx] returns the WRONG trial — and the returned winner_tstat (the sentinel's) does not match the returned trial's own series. The fix iterates filtered_trials so the index space is consistent.
citation: Harvey & Liu 2015; validation/overfitting.md H3; GATE2-PLAN A4.
provenance: Hand-authored raw-percent series. The consistency oracle (returned winner_tstat == compute_crra_eu_tstat over the returned winner's own U-transformed series) is DERIVED at runtime; no t-stat literal is pinned. The 'strong' series is all-positive (high t-stat, clears the gate); the 'weak' series is borderline (low t-stat, would lose the argmin if scored against the strong one).

constants._note: _SORTINO_SENTINEL is read live from math_engine; the gamma=2.0 U-transform mirrors _haircut_select's CRRA branch.

sentinel_before_real_trial_index_mismatc.description: completed_trials = [sentinel(strong series), real(weak series)]. The internal sentinel filter removes the sentinel -> filtered_trials = [real]. Pre-fix the loop scores BOTH, the sentinel's strong series wins the argmin (winner_idx=0 in completed-space), and filtered_trials[0] returns the WEAK real trial with the SENTINEL's t-stat (mismatch). Post-fix the loop ignores the sentinel; only the real trial is scored, so the returned t-stat matches the returned trial's own series.
sentinel_before_real_trial_index_mismatc._assertion_kind: consistency — IF a winner is returned, returned winner_tstat == compute_crra_eu_tstat over the winner's OWN U-transformed series. Pre-fix this is violated (11.94 vs 0.999). No literal pinned.

sentinel_only_returns_none.description: Regression: a single sentinel-only trial must return (None, None, None) — the sentinel filter must remain.
